snippet.title: Knuckle Creek Official release date trailer (sing a long version)
snippet.description:
*Anthony* wrote and performed this cracking little song featured in the trailer and we just had to use it. It's catchy, funny and amazingly informative about the game and most importantly catches the true spirit of Knuckle Creek. 

This is the sing a long version. Sing loud and Proud :) 

Knuckle Creek is a comedy brawler made for friends to play together.  Last player Standing, Team battles, or crank up the bots for some hilarious co-op action. Single player Challenge maps with Steam friend leader boards are the perfect training grounds.

*Releasing on Steam 29th October 2026.*
*Wishlist here:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/4652930/Knuckle_Creek/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=knuckle_creek_announce_trailer_2026&utm_content=announce_trailer
